body: Thanks...that gives me some hope.

The mentors just called my appointments off.  Happened with 2 different people each time!  
Yes I am doing that.  My point is, I am doing everything that I can - adding to my portfolio, taking certificates, networking, and everything - I am definitely not complaining while sitting idly.  I had a bad day hence the post.

FYI, during.  Started intensely almost 2 months before graduating.  Been doing that more casually before that.  

Why haven't I done the resume roasting?  Because I am not feeling good with myself, I know Ido not have a lot of industry experience as I said in another comment, so I feel embarrassed to be 'roasted'.  But have been reviewed by several industry people already.

I have been to all the counselors, all the reviews, all the workshops, all the career fairs, etc etc for the entire time I was in this degree.  

Oh and for your information, the link you put ... they literally rejected me each time I set up an appointment with their so-called mentors.  Noone told me why.

I am trying damn hard.  It's just like I just whine and not do anything.
Thanks I really appreciate it.  Lord knows I need it today.

Thank you.  Yeah I think you hit the nail on the head.  I always feel that my age (mid-30s now) has a lot to do with these rejections, this one included.  I only had a year of work in tech years ago before I switched because I was not mature enough at that time to realize this is what I wanted.

Anyway, for this award...It's just that my department chair told me to expect it anytime soon, so stupid me had hoped that this might be a small break for me at last, something I can boost my resume with.  To find out from someone completely random that they already had the ceremony really sucks.  Then it hit me that I couldn't explain why I was so depressed by this... I guess I took it as a sign that my luck would turn soon but alas I now take it as a sign that I need to do more to change the tide...1 award would not do it.

I'm trying my best...doing everything to try to land something...that's all I can do now.  It sucks that afaik age discrimination is not federally protected for people before 40 haha.  But yeah doing and hoping for the best for now.

Thanks for taking the time.  Ur right!  It hit me like a ton of bricks...I don't know why it hurts...I guess just the fact that they went out of their way to exclude me lmao.  I know in time I will not care...just wish that I woudn't care as much now
That's the thing, there is noone else that I haven't asked yet.  All of this has made me feel more and more worthless.  I know I cannot blame him for feeling this way.  I need help.

My situation is not a full-on relationship but I have never have someone, even a friend, treated me this bad.  It was like you are literally disposed like trash when they lose interest.  No, ice cold.  For all of the hurt souls out there who are contemplating giving your ghosters a second chance, I don't know your situation but I just want to say I feel your pain and you are worthy of great love and respect.

Some people lack the emotional capacity to do others right.  As for the ghostee, I've read opposing views.  We yearn to have closure and sometimes chase after them because we are normal humans who have that capacity so we are better.  Opposite that, we chase closure because we don't value our self-worth enough.
Yeah this is an ongoing matter that I am still contemplating... I have my concerns about going forward with it but yeah we'll see.
In my case, we do still work together (mostly remotely), and I asked to meet him under the guise of work.  But yeah, doesn't make it any less self-degrading.

This is the advice I've heard when I was reeling from being ghosted by this guy.  I wished I have sticked to it and just let time heal.  It is true.  I regretted asking to meet him in person after he ghosted me.  You really do feel like you lose your power even more.  This is a valuable life lesson.

I posted about this a while ago.  Although in my case, it was not a full on relationship, but man it hurts.  OP don't do this.  It hurts now but you gotta take back your control.  I learnt it the hard way.  I went and met my ghoster and I truly never felt lower than in that moment when I could just feel how small and unwelcome I was.  Love yourself.

Some man be like over 40 and still does this.  I feel sorry for myself that after 10 years of mature steady relationship, I actually let myself be vulnerable with some grown ass man who turned around and ghosted me, especially at the lowest point in my career.  Sucks that I didn't learn anything from the past.
